_MD010_comment: Tabs allowed inside fenced code blocks — Go and Makefile examples need them.
_MD013_comment: Disable hard line-length limit. Many docs are table-heavy or quote longer-form prose (Contributor Covenant) that we cannot reflow.
_MD031_comment: Don't require blank lines around fenced code. Several existing docs inline fences inside list items without padding; tightening this would touch every file.
_MD040_comment: Don't require a language on every fenced code block. CHANGELOG.md release-please blocks and a few snippet examples ship without one; revisit in a docs cleanup pass.
_MD041_comment: Allow first-line content other than H1 — README.md leads with an HTML hero banner, several other docs lead with badges.
_MD012_comment: Allow up to 2 consecutive blank lines (default 1). Lets sections breathe in the longer category docs.
_MD024_comment: Allow duplicate headings as long as they sit under different parents. Per-action subsections in usage/categories/*.md repeat common headings (### Quit, ### Force Quit, …).
_MD036_comment: Allow emphasis-as-heading. The category docs use **bold** as inline section titles inside lists (e.g. the Buttons sub-headings).
_MD046_comment: Require fenced code blocks (no indented ones). Matches what the entire repo already does.
_MD004_comment: Per-file consistency for unordered-list bullets. CHANGELOG.md uses '*' (release-please's conventional-changelog formatter); the rest of the repo uses '-'. Both valid; each file is internally consistent.
_MD060_comment: Disable strict table-column-style — existing tables mix compact (`| a | b |`) and padded layouts; harmonising them isn't worth the diff churn.
_MD033_comment: Inline HTML allowlist. `<picture>` + `<source>` cover the README hero banner's theme-aware art direction; `<kbd>` lets the docs show key chords; the rest are common in folded sections and the issue templates.
